project.name: strata-mcp
project.description: Local memory layer for AI agents — coding assistants over MCP, game NPCs over REST. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

nodes.name: longmemeval-tirqdp-baseline.ts
nodes.summary: Benchmark harness measuring task-averaged LongMemEval accuracy of Strata's search pipeline with the TIR+QDP flag on versus off, covering corpus ingest, per-question search, answer generation, and judging.
nodes.languageNotes: Standalone tsx script deliberately gated against accidental runs (costs $30-50 in OpenAI calls); supports --dry-run and stratified question selection.

nodes.name: loadEnv
nodes.summary: Loads environment variables from the local .env file so API keys are available without external tooling.

nodes.name: parseArgs
nodes.summary: Parses CLI flags (--flag, --qset, --qset-strategy, --dry-run) into a typed benchmark configuration.

nodes.name: stratifiedSelect
nodes.summary: Selects a question subset stratified by question type so small runs remain representative of the full 500-question set.

nodes.name: searchIngested
nodes.summary: Runs Strata's search pipeline against the ingested corpus for one benchmark question and collects retrieval results.

nodes.name: runVerifyFlagPath
nodes.summary: Pre-flight verification that the TIR+QDP code path actually toggles with the flag before committing to an expensive full run.

nodes.name: computeAbilityScores
nodes.summary: Aggregates per-question judge verdicts into per-ability accuracy scores for task-averaged reporting.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the complete benchmark run: argument parsing, corpus ingest, per-question search, answer generation, judging, and score reporting.

nodes.name: build-index.ts
nodes.summary: CLI command performing a full index build: enumerates and parses session files, extracts knowledge, synthesizes learnings, and writes memory files.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Drives the full index build pipeline from session enumeration through knowledge extraction, learning synthesis, and memory writing.

nodes.name: install.ts
nodes.summary: CLI installer that registers the Strata session-start hook and skill in the host assistant's settings and ensures the ~/.strata data directory exists.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Runs the three install steps (hook registration, skill copy, data directory creation) and reports completion.

nodes.name: installHook
nodes.summary: Registers the session-start hook in ~/.claude/settings.json, merging with existing hook configuration without clobbering user entries.

nodes.name: installSkill
nodes.summary: Copies the Strata skill definition into the assistant's skills directory.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Central configuration module: filesystem paths plus all empirically tuned search, ranking, indexing, importance, and evidence-gap parameters. Values are AutoResearch-optimized and must not be hand-edited without re-running evals.
nodes.languageNotes: Single exported CONFIG const with lazy getters for derived paths; roughly 34 tunable parameters consumed across the whole engine.

nodes.name: enhanced-extractor.ts
nodes.summary: LLM-powered knowledge extraction: formats session transcripts, prompts a configured LlmProvider, repairs and parses JSON responses into KnowledgeEntry objects, merges them with heuristic extraction, and captures training pairs for distillation.

nodes.name: enhancedExtract
nodes.summary: Top-level LLM extraction entry: builds the prompt from a parsed session, invokes the provider, parses and repairs the response, merges with heuristic entries, and saves training pairs.

nodes.name: formatTranscript
nodes.summary: Renders parsed session messages into a compact plain-text transcript for the extraction prompt.

nodes.name: parseExtractionResponse
nodes.summary: Parses the LLM's JSON extraction response into typed extraction items, tolerating wrapper noise.

nodes.name: toKnowledgeEntry
nodes.summary: Converts a raw LLM extraction item into a normalized KnowledgeEntry with type, tags, and session metadata.

nodes.name: mergeEntries
nodes.summary: Merges LLM-extracted entries with heuristic entries, deduplicating on normalized content keys.

nodes.name: parseWithRepair
nodes.summary: Attempts strict JSON.parse and falls back to repair strategies (fence stripping, bracket balancing) for malformed LLM output.

nodes.name: extractJson
nodes.summary: Locates and extracts the first JSON object or array embedded in free-form LLM response text.

nodes.name: session-start-hook.ts
nodes.summary: SessionStart hook executable that injects pre-computed project context (summaries, learnings, recurring issues, evidence gaps) into new Claude Code or Gemini CLI sessions, targeting under 200ms.
nodes.languageNotes: Dual-output design: plain text on stdout for Claude Code, structured JSON for Gemini CLI, selected by environment detection.

nodes.name: drainStdin
nodes.summary: Reads and parses the hook's stdin payload with a timeout so the hook never hangs on a silent host.

nodes.name: emitOutput
nodes.summary: Writes hook output in the host-appropriate shape — plain text for Claude Code, JSON for Gemini CLI.

nodes.name: handleCompact
nodes.summary: Handles the compact trigger by re-injecting condensed project context after a context-window compaction.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Hook entry point: resolves the project, loads summaries, learnings, recurring issues, and gap counts from SQLite, and emits the session-start context block.

nodes.name: loadTopRecurringIssue
nodes.summary: Loads the highest-scoring recurring issue from the recurring-issues file for inclusion in the context block.

nodes.name: conflict-resolver.ts
nodes.summary: LLM-based conflict resolution between a new knowledge entry and contradicting stored entries: builds the resolution prompt, parses the verdict, and executes update/supersede/keep-both actions against the knowledge store.

nodes.name: resolveConflicts
nodes.summary: Finds potentially conflicting stored entries for a new memory, prompts the LLM for a resolution verdict, and returns the structured resolution.

nodes.name: executeResolution
nodes.summary: Applies a parsed resolution verdict to the store — updating, superseding, or keeping both entries.

nodes.name: buildPrompt
nodes.summary: Constructs the conflict-resolution prompt presenting the new entry against existing candidates with strict output instructions.

nodes.name: parseResponse
nodes.summary: Parses and validates the LLM's resolution response into a typed verdict, rejecting malformed actions.

nodes.name: dedup.ts
nodes.summary: Near-duplicate detection for knowledge entries using character-trigram Jaccard similarity; checkDuplicate classifies new content as duplicate, enrichment, or genuinely new.

nodes.name: getTrigrams
nodes.summary: Builds the character trigram set for a normalized string.

nodes.name: trigramJaccard
nodes.summary: Computes Jaccard similarity between two strings' trigram sets.

nodes.name: addsNewDetail
nodes.summary: Checks whether candidate text contributes meaningful new tokens beyond an existing entry.

nodes.name: checkDuplicate
nodes.summary: Classifies a candidate entry against stored entries as duplicate, enrichment, or new based on trigram similarity thresholds.

nodes.name: importance.ts
nodes.summary: Importance scoring for knowledge entries: type-based weights (TYPE_IMPORTANCE), language-marker boosts, and role-based type inference used at store time and during ranking.

nodes.name: computeImportance
nodes.summary: Computes a 0-1 importance score for an entry from its type weight, language markers, and content signals.

nodes.name: inferTypeFromRole
nodes.summary: Infers the most likely knowledge type for content based on speaker role and phrasing cues.

nodes.name: computeLanguageScore
nodes.summary: Scores content by counting decisive or imperative language markers that signal durable knowledge.

nodes.name: knowledge-evaluator.ts
nodes.summary: Quality gate for extracted knowledge: scores entries on actionability, specificity, and relevance so low-value extractions are filtered before storage.

nodes.name: KnowledgeEvaluator
nodes.summary: Evaluates a knowledge entry against actionability, specificity, and relevance heuristics and returns a keep/discard verdict with a score.

nodes.name: knowledge-extractor.ts
nodes.summary: Heuristic pattern-based knowledge extraction from parsed session messages — decisions, error fixes, learnings, preferences — with tag and file-path extraction, trigram dedup, and an evaluator-gated variant.

nodes.name: extractKnowledge
nodes.summary: Scans parsed session messages with pattern rules to produce typed KnowledgeEntry objects with context, tags, and file paths.

nodes.name: getContext
nodes.summary: Collects surrounding message text to attach conversational context to an extracted entry.

nodes.name: extractTags
nodes.summary: Derives lowercase tags from entry content using technology and topic keyword matching.

nodes.name: extractFilePaths
nodes.summary: Extracts file path mentions from content via regex for entry metadata.

nodes.name: extractEvaluatedKnowledge
nodes.summary: Runs extraction then filters results through KnowledgeEvaluator, returning only entries that pass the quality gate.

nodes.name: knowledge-store.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the KnowledgeEntry shape and KNOWLEDGE_TYPES taxonomy plus a legacy JSON-file-backed KnowledgeStore; the type definitions are imported across the entire engine while SQLite persistence supersedes the JSON store.

nodes.name: KnowledgeStore
nodes.summary: JSON-file-backed store offering add, search, load, save and per-project/per-type lookups over KnowledgeEntry objects.

nodes.name: learning-synthesizer.ts
nodes.summary: Synthesizes cross-session learnings by clustering similar knowledge entries with stemmed Jaccard similarity, scoring clusters, and producing the recurring-issues file consumed by hooks and tools.

nodes.name: synthesizeLearnings
nodes.summary: Clusters knowledge entries and converts qualifying clusters into synthesized learning entries.

nodes.name: clusterEntries
nodes.summary: Greedy clustering of entries whose stemmed-word Jaccard similarity exceeds the configured threshold.

nodes.name: scoreCluster
nodes.summary: Scores a cluster by size, recency, and entry importance to rank learning candidates.

nodes.name: createLearning
nodes.summary: Builds a synthesized learning entry from a cluster, composing content, tags, and a deterministic id.

nodes.name: buildRecurringIssues
nodes.summary: Derives recurring issue records from error-fix clusters for the recurring-issues file.

nodes.name: jaccardSimilarity
nodes.summary: Computes Jaccard similarity between two word sets.

nodes.name: stemmedWords
nodes.summary: Tokenizes content into a stemmed, stop-word-filtered word set for similarity comparison.

nodes.name: memory-writer.ts
nodes.summary: Writes synthesized learnings into assistant memory files (CLAUDE.md, Cline rules, etc.) inside a managed marker section, preserving user-authored content and resolving per-assistant write paths.

nodes.name: clineGlobalStoragePath
nodes.summary: Resolves Cline's platform-specific global storage directory for memory file placement.

nodes.name: getMemoryWritePath
nodes.summary: Returns the memory file path for a given assistant target and project.

nodes.name: migrateLegacyMarkers
nodes.summary: Upgrades old managed-section marker comments in existing memory files to the current format.

nodes.name: writeLearningsToMemory
nodes.summary: Writes filtered learnings into the managed section of the target memory file, creating or replacing the block atomically.

nodes.name: replaceManagedSection
nodes.summary: Replaces only the marker-delimited managed section of a memory file, leaving user content untouched.

nodes.name: getUserLineCount
nodes.summary: Counts user-authored (non-managed) lines to enforce size budgets on memory files.

nodes.name: filterLearningsForProject
nodes.summary: Filters synthesized learnings to those relevant to a specific project before writing.

nodes.name: procedure-extractor.ts
nodes.summary: Extracts step-by-step procedures from session content using four strategies — numbered lists, step headers, ordinal-flow prose, and sequential tool-use runs — with title inference and detail parsing.

nodes.name: parseProcedureDetails
nodes.summary: Parses a stored procedure entry's content back into structured title and steps.

nodes.name: extractProcedures
nodes.summary: Runs all procedure detection strategies over session messages and emits procedure-type knowledge entries.

nodes.name: extractNumberedList
nodes.summary: Detects explicit numbered-list step sequences in message text.

nodes.name: extractStepHeaders
nodes.summary: Detects 'Step N' header style procedures.

nodes.name: extractOrdinalFlow
nodes.summary: Detects prose procedures expressed with ordinal connectives (first/then/finally).

nodes.name: inferTitle
nodes.summary: Infers a concise procedure title from surrounding context or the first step.

nodes.name: findSequentialToolUseIndices
nodes.summary: Finds runs of consecutive assistant tool-use messages that constitute an implicit procedure.

nodes.name: profile-synthesizer.ts
nodes.summary: Synthesizes a developer profile — expertise, preferences, workflow, tech stack, evolution, gaps, and contradictions — from stored knowledge, entities, and summaries, with full and compact formatters for the get_user_profile tool.

nodes.name: synthesizeProfile
nodes.summary: Top-level profile builder orchestrating all dimension synthesizers into a single profile object.

nodes.name: synthesizeExpertise
nodes.summary: Derives expertise areas with confidence levels from knowledge entry density and entity mentions.

nodes.name: synthesizePreferences
nodes.summary: Extracts stated and inferred user preferences from preference-type knowledge entries.

nodes.name: synthesizeWorkflow
nodes.summary: Characterizes the user's working patterns (testing habits, tooling, session rhythms) from knowledge and summaries.

nodes.name: synthesizeStack
nodes.summary: Builds the user's technology stack picture from entities and knowledge, grouped by category with recency.

nodes.name: synthesizeEvolution
nodes.summary: Tracks how the user's focus and stack have shifted across time windows.

nodes.name: synthesizeGaps
nodes.summary: Summarizes open evidence gaps and adjacent-expertise opportunities for the profile.

nodes.name: findAdjacentExpertise
nodes.summary: Suggests adjacent skills based on existing expertise clusters.

nodes.name: synthesizeContradictions
nodes.summary: Detects contradictory preference and decision pairs in stored knowledge for surfacing in the profile.

nodes.name: formatProfile
nodes.summary: Renders the full profile object as readable markdown sections.

nodes.name: formatProfileCompact
nodes.summary: Renders an abbreviated profile for budget-constrained contexts.

nodes.name: history-parser.ts
nodes.summary: Parses ~/.claude/history.jsonl into typed entries and groups them by session and project; getProjectInfos summarizes per-project activity for tools like list_projects.

nodes.name: parseHistoryFile
nodes.summary: Reads and parses history.jsonl line-by-line into typed history entries, skipping malformed lines.

nodes.name: groupBySession
nodes.summary: Groups history entries into per-session buckets.

nodes.name: groupByProject
nodes.summary: Groups history entries by project directory.

nodes.name: getProjectInfos
nodes.summary: Builds per-project summaries (entry counts, first/last activity) from grouped history.

nodes.name: evidence-gaps.ts
nodes.summary: Evidence gap tracking: records gaps when searches return empty or low-confidence results, auto-resolves them when matching knowledge is later stored, and provides listing, occurrence counts, summaries, and dismissal over SQLite.

nodes.name: normalizeGapKey
nodes.summary: Normalizes a query string into a canonical gap key for matching repeat occurrences.

nodes.name: pruneGaps
nodes.summary: Deletes stale or excess gap rows to keep the gaps table bounded.

nodes.name: recordGap
nodes.summary: Inserts or increments an evidence gap when a search under-delivers, deduplicating by normalized key.

nodes.name: resolveGaps
nodes.summary: Marks open gaps as resolved when a newly stored knowledge entry answers them.

nodes.name: listGaps
nodes.summary: Queries gaps with status, project, and occurrence filters and enriches them for display.

nodes.name: getGapOccurrences
nodes.summary: Returns the occurrence count for a matching open gap.

nodes.name: getGapSummary
nodes.summary: Computes dashboard statistics: open and resolved counts, average time-to-resolution, and the most persistent gap.

nodes.name: dismissGap
nodes.summary: Marks a gap as dismissed so it stops surfacing.

nodes.name: knowledge-to-search-result.ts
nodes.summary: Adapter converting KnowledgeEntry rows into SearchResult objects with provenance handles so stored knowledge can flow through the unified search ranking pipeline.

nodes.name: knowledgeEntryToSearchResult
nodes.summary: Maps one KnowledgeEntry to a SearchResult, attaching score, snippet, and ProvenanceHandle fields.

nodes.name: knowledgeEntriesToSearchResults
nodes.summary: Batch wrapper mapping an entry array through knowledgeEntryToSearchResult.

nodes.name: model-router.ts
nodes.summary: Model-aware retrieval routing: classifies the consuming model's context-window size from its name and returns tuned retrieval parameters (sessionTopK, reranker use); opt-in via CONFIG.modelRouting.

nodes.name: detectModelProfile
nodes.summary: Matches a model name against known patterns to classify it as large, medium, or small context.

nodes.name: getRetrievalParams
nodes.summary: Returns the tuned retrieval parameter set for a model profile.

nodes.name: resolveModelRouting
nodes.summary: Resolves the final routing decision from explicit parameter or detection, honoring the opt-in flag.

nodes.name: entity-store.ts
nodes.summary: Async-first IEntityStore contract plus entity row, input, relation, and graph types for entity graph persistence, implemented by the SQLite, Postgres, and D1 adapters.
nodes.languageNotes: All methods return Promise<T> so synchronous SQLite and asynchronous D1/Postgres adapters share one contract.

nodes.name: evidence-gap-store.ts
nodes.summary: IEvidenceGapStore async interface defining record, resolve, list, summary, and dismiss operations so evidence-gap persistence can be backed by SQLite, Postgres, or future adapters.

nodes.name: pg-evidence-gap-store.ts
nodes.summary: Postgres implementation of IEvidenceGapStore mirroring the SQLite evidence-gaps functions — record, prune, resolve, list, summary, dismiss — over a pg connection pool.

nodes.name: rowToGap
nodes.summary: Maps a Postgres row to the EvidenceGap shape used by the search layer.

nodes.name: PgEvidenceGapStore
nodes.summary: Implements the full IEvidenceGapStore contract with parameterized SQL against the evidence_gaps table.

nodes.name: sqlite-knowledge-store.ts
nodes.summary: Primary SQLite-backed knowledge persistence: CRUD with FTS5 search, async Gemini embedding writes with turbo-quant quantization, batched embedding flushes, edit history tracking, procedure merging, and type distribution stats — the IKnowledgeStore reference implementation.
nodes.languageNotes: Embeds asynchronously with batch coalescing; embeddings are quantized via turbo-quant before BLOB storage, and FTS queries are sanitized to prevent FTS5 syntax injection.

nodes.name: sanitizeFtsQuery
nodes.summary: Sanitizes raw user queries into safe FTS5 MATCH syntax, stripping operators that would error or inject.

nodes.name: encodeEmbeddingFor
nodes.summary: Encodes a float vector into the stored BLOB format, applying quantization when enabled for the model.

nodes.name: SqliteKnowledgeStore
nodes.summary: The core knowledge store: add, upsert, FTS5 search, update, and delete with history rows, batched async embedding writes, procedure merge, and aggregate statistics.

nodes.name: rowToEntry
nodes.summary: Maps a knowledge_entries row to the KnowledgeEntry object shape.

nodes.name: mergeStringArrays
nodes.summary: Merges and deduplicates two serialized string arrays for tag and file-path merging on upsert.

nodes.name: entryToRow
nodes.summary: Maps a KnowledgeEntry to its row representation for insert or update.

nodes.name: find-patterns.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool find_patterns: analyzes indexed history to surface recurring topics, activity patterns, and repeated issues across sessions.

nodes.name: handleFindPatterns
nodes.summary: Tool handler dispatching to topic, activity, and issue pattern analyzers based on the requested pattern type.

nodes.name: findTopicPatterns
nodes.summary: Computes recurring topic terms from tokenized history entries.

nodes.name: findActivityPatterns
nodes.summary: Derives activity rhythm patterns (busy hours, days, session cadence) from history timestamps.

nodes.name: findRepeatedIssues
nodes.summary: Finds error topics that recur across sessions, indicating unresolved problems.

nodes.name: find-solutions.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool find_solutions: searches past sessions and stored knowledge for fixes matching an error description, with confidence banding, evidence-gap recording on misses, and provenance-formatted responses.

nodes.name: toRecords
nodes.summary: Converts search results into serializable record objects for the response formatter.

nodes.name: searchSolutionsViaStore
nodes.summary: Queries the knowledge store for solution and error-fix entries matching the problem text.

nodes.name: handleFindSolutions
nodes.summary: Tool handler orchestrating session search plus knowledge search, merging and banding results by confidence, recording evidence gaps, and building the final response.

nodes.name: get-project-context.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool get_project_context: assembles comprehensive project context — recent sessions, key knowledge, top terms, provenance sources — for injecting cross-session memory at session start.

nodes.name: buildProvenanceSources
nodes.summary: Builds the provenance source list attached to context responses.

nodes.name: handleGetProjectContext
nodes.summary: Tool handler gathering sessions, knowledge entries, and term statistics for a project into a single context payload.

nodes.name: get-session-summary.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool get_session_summary: locates a session by id or most-recent-for-project and formats a structured summary with key phrases and activity stats.

nodes.name: handleGetSessionSummary
nodes.summary: Tool handler resolving the target session and returning its formatted summary.

nodes.name: findSessionById
nodes.summary: Locates a session file by session id across project directories.

nodes.name: findLatestSessionForProject
nodes.summary: Finds the most recently modified session file for a project path.

nodes.name: formatSessionSummary
nodes.summary: Formats a parsed session into a readable summary block with stats, topics, and key exchanges.

nodes.name: extractKeyPhrases
nodes.summary: Extracts frequent meaningful phrases from session text for the summary.

nodes.name: ingest-document.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool ingest_document: converts external document text into stored knowledge entries with importance scoring and duplicate awareness.

nodes.name: handleIngestDocument
nodes.summary: Tool handler validating input, normalizing document content, scoring importance, and persisting entries to the knowledge store.

nodes.name: list-projects.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool list_projects: enumerates projects with conversation history and returns activity metadata in the compact serialized response format.

nodes.name: toRecords
nodes.summary: Converts project info objects to serializable records for the response formatter.

nodes.name: handleListProjects
nodes.summary: Tool handler listing known projects with entry counts and recency, serialized via CompactSerializer.

nodes.name: search-history.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool search_history — the main retrieval entry point: fuses FTS, TIR+QDP, knowledge, and dense turn-lane channels, resolves the retrieval strategy, applies model routing and confidence banding, and emits provenance-cited responses including the agent format.
nodes.languageNotes: handleSearchHistory is the production read path; TIR+QDP fusion and the dense turn-lane are flag-gated (CONFIG.search.useTirQdp, STRATA_DENSE_TURN_LANE).

nodes.name: searchKnowledge
nodes.summary: Searches stored knowledge entries and adapts them into SearchResult objects for fusion with session results.

nodes.name: toRecords
nodes.summary: Converts fused search results into serializable records with provenance fields.

nodes.name: buildAgentContext
nodes.summary: Builds the dedup-to-sessions agent-format context block from fused results.

nodes.name: searchKnowledgeViaStore
nodes.summary: Runs knowledge search through an injected IKnowledgeStore for backend-agnostic retrieval.

nodes.name: handleSearchHistory
nodes.summary: The production search handler: parses query filters, fans out across retrieval lanes, fuses and ranks results, records evidence gaps, and formats the response per requested format and verbosity.

nodes.name: store-memory.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool store_memory: persists an explicit memory with importance scoring, entity extraction and linking, async embeddings, LLM conflict resolution, evidence-gap resolution, and routing of large content to document storage.

nodes.name: handleStoreMemory
nodes.summary: Tool handler validating and storing a memory: scores importance, extracts entities and relations, embeds, resolves conflicts with stored entries, resolves matching evidence gaps, and delegates oversized content to store_document.

nodes.name: provenance.ts
nodes.summary: ProvenanceHandle interface — the structured citation handle (id, session id, created/updated timestamps, edit count) backing the bracket-handle citations in agent-facing search responses.

nodes.name: compact-serializer.ts
nodes.summary: CompactSerializer renders tool responses at concise, standard, or detailed verbosity, selecting fields from FIELD_CONFIGS and delegating to the TOON serializer for token-efficient output.

nodes.name: CompactSerializer
nodes.summary: Serializes record arrays at the requested verbosity, choosing field subsets and TOON or standard rendering.

nodes.name: field-config.ts
nodes.summary: Declares FIELD_CONFIGS — which result fields each response verbosity level includes per tool — with the getFieldsForFormat accessor.

nodes.name: getFieldsForFormat
nodes.summary: Looks up the field list for a tool and format level, falling back to defaults.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Central CONFIG singleton: filesystem paths under ~/.claude and ~/.strata plus all empirically tuned search parameters (BM25, TF-IDF, ranking, chunking, importance scoring, evidence gaps, model routing) optimized via frozen AutoResearch evals.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses getter properties for derived paths on a single CONFIG object; parameters are AutoResearch-optimized and must not be changed without re-running the frozen evals.

nodes.name: format-provenance.ts
nodes.summary: Formats ProvenanceHandle records into the compact bracket-citation string ([mem:<id> sess:<id> t:<date>]) used inline in agent-facing search tool responses.

nodes.name: formatProvenanceHandle
nodes.summary: Builds the bracket-citation string from a provenance handle, shortening entry and session ids to 6 hex chars while preserving their type prefix, and rendering a UTC ISO date.

nodes.name: path-encoder.ts
nodes.summary: Encodes and decodes Claude Code's dash-encoded project directory names (e.g. /Users/jon/dev/ghostty -> -Users-jon-dev-ghostty), with helpers to extract a short project name and match a cwd against known project dirs.

nodes.name: encodeProjectPath
nodes.summary: Replaces path separators and drive-letter colons with dashes, mirroring Claude Code's project directory naming on both Unix and Windows.

nodes.name: decodeProjectPath
nodes.summary: Best-effort reverse of the dash encoding back to a slash-separated path (loses Windows drive colons).

nodes.name: extractProjectName
nodes.summary: Derives a short project name from an encoded or raw path by normalizing and taking the last non-empty path segment.

nodes.name: matchProjectDir
nodes.summary: Matches a working directory against a list of encoded project dirs using exact match first, then bidirectional prefix matching for subdirectories.

nodes.name: response-format.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the ResponseFormat verbosity enum (concise/standard/detailed/agent) controlling tool output token usage, plus selectFormat() to detect the requested format from tool parameters.

nodes.name: selectFormat
nodes.summary: Validates an optional format parameter against the ResponseFormat enum and falls back to STANDARD when absent or invalid.

nodes.name: response.ts
nodes.summary: Token-optimized MCP tool response builders: compact JSON with _meta tool tracking, a 25,000-token character-limit enforcer, text responses with optional guidance, and preview truncation.

nodes.name: enforceCharacterLimit
nodes.summary: Truncates response text exceeding the ~25,000-token character budget (100k chars) and flags whether truncation occurred.

nodes.name: buildToolResponse
nodes.summary: Builds a compact (non-pretty-printed) JSON MCP tool response with _meta tool/timestamp metadata, optional cached flag and next-step guidance, under the character limit.

nodes.name: buildTextResponse
nodes.summary: Builds a plain-text MCP tool response with optional appended guidance, enforcing the character limit.

nodes.name: truncatePreview
nodes.summary: Truncates text to a preview length (default 500 chars) and appends the total word count.

nodes.name: toon-serializer.ts
nodes.summary: TOON (Token-Optimized Object Notation) serializer rendering arrays of objects as compact entity[count]{fields} tabular text for 30-60% token reduction vs JSON, with a round-trip parser for testing.

nodes.name: ToonSerializer
nodes.summary: Static serialize/parse pair converting object arrays to and from the TOON tabular format, escaping embedded commas and newlines in string fields.

nodes.name: file-watcher.ts
nodes.summary: Multi-directory fs.watch-based watcher monitoring session-file directories for Claude Code, Codex, Cline, Gemini CLI and extra env-configured dirs, dispatching change callbacks tagged with parser ids.

nodes.name: getWatchTargets
nodes.summary: Builds the default watch-target list for all known parsers (Claude Code, Codex, Cline, Gemini CLI) plus extra dirs from CONFIG.extraWatchDirs, parsing dir:ext entries with Windows drive-letter awareness and filtering to directories that exist.

nodes.name: FileWatcher
nodes.summary: Manages one fs.watch per watch target, filtering raw events through matchesTarget and forwarding matching file paths with their parser id to a change callback.

nodes.name: matchesTarget
nodes.summary: Checks a changed filename against a watch target's glob-style pattern and allowed extension list.

nodes.name: getClineTasksDir
nodes.summary: Resolves the platform-specific VS Code globalStorage path where the Cline extension stores its task conversation files.

nodes.name: incremental-indexer.ts
nodes.summary: Incremental indexing orchestrator: on watched session-file changes it re-parses only the changed session and runs the full knowledge pipeline — heuristic or LLM-enhanced extraction, summarization, entity/relation/procedure extraction, conflict resolution, importance scoring, learning synthesis, and MEMORY.md writing.
nodes.languageNotes: Depends on narrow structural interfaces (IndexManagerLike, IndexerKnowledgeStore) rather than concrete stores, so it works with both the JSON and SQLite index backends.

nodes.name: resolveProjectDir
nodes.summary: Maps a parser id and changed filename to the projectDir slug each parser produces during discovery (cline/<taskId>, codex/<y>/<m>/<d>, gemini/<hash>, ...), keeping incremental and full-index paths consistent.

nodes.name: IncrementalIndexer
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the watch -> parse -> extract -> store cycle: routes file changes through the ParserRegistry, runs knowledge/entity/procedure extraction with optional LLM providers, resolves conflicts, scores importance, and persists summaries and learnings.

nodes.name: realtime-watcher.ts
nodes.summary: Real-time watcher for an active Claude Code session JSONL file: fs.watch with a 5s debounce, incremental parsing of only new lines via parsePartial, and heuristic knowledge extraction into the SQLite knowledge store.

nodes.name: RealtimeWatcher
nodes.summary: Tracks a read offset into the live session JSONL, debounces fs.watch events, parses only newly appended lines, and stores extracted knowledge entries tagged with the session's project dir and session id.

nodes.name: cognitive-retrieval-benchmark.test.ts
nodes.summary: Benchmark suite comparing search quality before and after importance scoring — reports MRR and Top-1 accuracy against spec targets (MRR +0.15, Top-1 >= 70%) and exercises the evidence-gap record/dedup/resolve lifecycle.

nodes.name: seedDatabase
nodes.summary: Seeds the in-memory document store with the fixture corpus used by the cognitive retrieval benchmark queries.

nodes.name: BM25Index

nodes.name: index-manager.ts
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the in-memory full-text index: enumerates and parses session files, chunks them, and keeps parallel BM25 and TF-IDF indexes plus a document store in sync, with msgpack persistence and a JSON fallback.

nodes.name: IndexManager
nodes.summary: Builds and maintains the search index — full rebuilds, incremental updates, per-file indexing into BM25/TF-IDF/document stores, session removal, and save/load via msgpack with JSON fallback.

nodes.name: tfidf.ts
nodes.summary: TF-IDF vector index with cosine-similarity search, document-frequency tracking, and serialization, forming the second lane of the hybrid search stack alongside BM25.

nodes.name: TFIDFIndex
nodes.summary: TF-IDF index with log-scaled term weighting, lazily computed document vectors, candidate-pruned cosine-similarity top-k search, and JSON serialization.

nodes.name: tokenizer.ts
nodes.summary: Shared tokenizer for indexing and search: lowercases, handles code and punctuation, removes stop words and pure numbers, applies stemming, and optionally emits bigrams.

nodes.name: tokenize
nodes.summary: Normalizes raw text into stemmed search tokens — lowercasing, camelCase and code handling, stop-word and numeric filtering, and optional bigram emission.

nodes.name: termFrequency
nodes.summary: Counts term occurrences in a token list into a frequency map for index construction.

nodes.name: query-processor.ts
nodes.summary: Parses raw search queries into clean free text plus structured filters (project:, tool:, before:, after:) with both relative (7d, 2w) and absolute date handling.

nodes.name: parseQuery
nodes.summary: Extracts project:/tool:/before:/after: filter directives from a raw query string and returns the cleaned free-text remainder plus a structured filters object.

nodes.name: parseDate
nodes.summary: Parses relative date expressions (e.g. 7d, 2w) and absolute date strings into epoch-millisecond timestamps.

nodes.name: recall-fusion-community.ts
nodes.summary: Community-surface Reciprocal Rank Fusion wrapper that merges knowledge-chunk hits and knowledge-turn FTS hits into one ranked candidate list, reusing the NPC recall-fusion math byte-for-byte while adapting input/output shapes to project + userId scoping.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure function by design — no internal state or cache; the RRF loop is intentionally kept byte-identical to fuseRecallLanes so any divergence is a bug.

nodes.name: fuseCommunityLanes
nodes.summary: Fuses pre-ranked chunk and turn lanes with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (rrfK from CONFIG), accumulating per-id scores and returning candidates sorted by fused score with stable tie-breaking.

nodes.name: recall-qdp-community.ts
nodes.summary: Query-Driven Pruning for the Community recall pipeline: trigram-Jaccard near-duplicate removal, filler-content suppression, and query-token coverage filtering over fused candidates before they reach the answer context.

nodes.name: recallQdpCommunity
nodes.summary: Prunes fused recall candidates via trigram-Jaccard dedupe, filler filtering, and query-token coverage checks, returning a budget-capped final list.

nodes.name: result-ranker.ts
nodes.summary: Core ranking layer for search: reciprocal rank fusion, recency/project/importance boosts at chunk and session level, filter application, and the turn-lane recency boost with per-session caps, speaker preference, and short-session corrections.
nodes.languageNotes: Boost weights and behavior flags come from CONFIG and were empirically tuned via AutoResearch evals — do not change without re-running the frozen eval suites.

nodes.name: reciprocalRankFusion
nodes.summary: Merges multiple ranked result lists into a single ordering by accumulating reciprocal-rank scores with a configurable k constant.

nodes.name: applyBoosts
nodes.summary: Applies recency, current-project, and importance boosts to chunk-level results, dedupes to the best chunk per session, and re-sorts by boosted score.

nodes.name: aggregateToSessionScores
nodes.summary: Rolls chunk-level relevance up to session level using a log2-damped sum over each session's top-scoring chunks.

nodes.name: applySessionBoosts
nodes.summary: Boosts session-level scores by recency, project match, and importance, then applies recency-dominant reordering when the query is a current-state question.

nodes.name: applyFilters
nodes.summary: Filters ranked results by project name, before/after time window, and tool-name constraints parsed from the query.

nodes.name: applyTurnRecencyBoost
nodes.summary: Turn-lane ranking pass: groups hits by session, orders sessions recency-first for temporal/current-state queries, applies within-session speaker preference and short-session corrections, then enforces per-session caps.

nodes.name: applyPerSessionCap
nodes.summary: Caps the number of turn hits kept per session and backfills from the overflow pool to preserve the overall result count.

nodes.name: applyWithinSessionSpeakerPrefer
nodes.summary: Reorders hits within each session so user turns are preferred over assistant turns at comparable relevance.

nodes.name: applyShortSessionDescCorrection
nodes.summary: Internal correction that reorders short sessions' hits descending by message index for duration and historical-marker questions.

nodes.name: search-engine.ts
nodes.summary: Hybrid in-memory search engine combining BM25 and TF-IDF lanes via reciprocal rank fusion, with filter and boost post-processing and a solution-focused search variant.

nodes.name: SearchEngine
nodes.summary: Search facade over IndexManager: parses the query, tokenizes it, runs BM25 and TF-IDF lanes, fuses with RRF, then applies filters and boosts; searchSolutions narrows results to fix/solution content.

nodes.name: knowledge-turn-store.ts

nodes.name: pg-knowledge-turn-store.ts

nodes.name: PgKnowledgeTurnStore
nodes.summary: Postgres-backed turn store implementing IKnowledgeTurnStore: tsvector search scoped by user/project, transactional bulk insert, optional dense per-turn embedding writes, and session-scoped retrieval and deletion.

nodes.name: sanitizeTsQuery
nodes.summary: Sanitizes raw query text into a safe to_tsquery expression, stripping operators that would break or inject into the tsquery parser.

nodes.name: SqliteKnowledgeTurnStore
nodes.summary: SQLite FTS5 turn store implementing IKnowledgeTurnStore with insert/bulkInsert, user- and project-scoped BM25 search, pending-embedding flush, and session-scoped retrieval and deletion.

nodes.name: runStatus

nodes.name: download.ts

nodes.name: readPolarKey

nodes.name: loadEnv
nodes.summary: Loads GEMINI_API_KEY and related variables from the repo-root .env file into process.env when not already set.

nodes.name: embedding-provider.ts

nodes.summary: Thin adapter wrapping GeminiEmbedder behind the EmbeddingProvider interface, exposing embed/embedBatch plus dimensions, model name, and quantization support flags.

nodes.name: agent-loop.ts

nodes.name: formatSessionResults
nodes.summary: Formats session-level search hits into compact numbered lines with ISO dates and text previews for the agent's tool-result messages.

nodes.name: executeTool
nodes.summary: Dispatches the agent's tool calls (search_sessions, search_events, get_session, search_knowledge, get_session_count, search_by_date_range) against the injected search engine, event store, knowledge store, and document store, returning formatted text results.

nodes.name: buildSystemPrompt
nodes.summary: Assembles the agent system prompt embedding the three GPT-4.1 agentic instructions (persistence, tool verification, planning/reflection), the question-type procedure, session count, and current date, repeating key instructions at the end.

nodes.name: runAgentLoop
nodes.summary: Entry point of the loop: classifies the question, selects procedure and tool subset, then iterates provider.chatWithTools rounds executing tool calls until the model answers or the iteration/budget cap forces a final-answer turn; returns the answer with tool-call log and token usage.

nodes.name: procedures.ts
nodes.summary: Question-type classification and step-by-step search procedures for the reasoning agent loop, shared by the reason_over_query (server-side) and get_search_procedure (client-side) MCP tools; ported from the LongMemEval benchmark.

nodes.name: isComparisonQuestion
nodes.summary: Regex predicate detecting superlative/ranking questions (most, least, highest, cheapest) that need exhaustive enumeration before comparison.

nodes.name: classifyQuestion
nodes.summary: Maps a question to one of five QuestionType categories (duration, counting, comparison, temporal, factual) by chaining the query-classifier predicates in priority order.

nodes.name: getProcedure
nodes.summary: Returns the step-by-step search procedure text for a given question type, used to steer the agent loop's system prompt.

nodes.name: getToolSubset
nodes.summary: Returns the per-question-type subset of agent tools to expose, limiting the loop's tool surface to what the procedure needs.

nodes.name: hybrid-search.ts

nodes.name: query-classifier.ts
nodes.summary: Regex-based query intent predicates (counting, duration, temporal, current-state, existential, historical markers) used by search ranking and the reasoning procedures to route questions to the right retrieval strategy.

nodes.name: isCountingQuestion
nodes.summary: Detects counting/aggregation questions (how many, how often, list all, total) while excluding duration phrasings.

nodes.name: isDurationQuestion
nodes.summary: Detects duration questions asking for spans of days, weeks, hours, months, years, or time.

nodes.name: isTemporalQuestion
nodes.summary: Detects when/what-date style temporal questions including ordering phrasings like 'which came first'.

nodes.name: isCurrentStateQuery
nodes.summary: Detects queries about present state (currently, still, now, latest, most recent) that should prefer recent evidence.

nodes.name: hasTemporalMarker
nodes.summary: Detects state-like technical nouns (version, node, branch, model, provider) whose answers change over time.

nodes.name: hasCurrentStateMarker
nodes.summary: Detects explicit present-tense markers (now, currently, today, what's my) signalling the question wants the latest value.

nodes.name: hasHistoricalMarker
nodes.summary: Detects explicit past-tense markers (last year, previously, used to, ago) signalling the question targets historical state.

nodes.name: isExistentialQuestion
nodes.summary: Detects 'Is X a/an/the Y' existence/identity questions that should not receive recency-preferring treatment.

nodes.name: isTemporalCurrentStateQuestion
nodes.summary: Composite predicate deciding whether a query is asking about the current value of time-varying state, combining current-state and temporal markers while excluding historical and existential questions.

nodes.name: semantic-search-bridge.ts

nodes.name: toSearchResults

nodes.name: SemanticSearchBridge
nodes.summary: Lazily wires VectorStore + embedding provider into a HybridSearchEngine, then serves search and searchSolutions calls with threshold filtering and a solution-keyword boost; returns null results when semantic search is unavailable.

nodes.name: toSearchResults

nodes.name: knowledge-store.ts

nodes.name: SqliteDocumentStore

nodes.name: rowToChunk

nodes.name: vector-search.ts
nodes.summary: SQLite vector search backend: brute-force cosine similarity over Float32Array embeddings with a fast path that routes quantized blobs to the ADC/SDC quantized-domain pipeline. Defines the IVectorSearch interface that the Postgres and D1 backends implement, and covers knowledge entries, document chunks, and per-turn embeddings.
nodes.languageNotes: No external math library — typed-array loops only. All methods are async despite wrapping synchronous better-sqlite3 calls, so async backends (Postgres pool, D1 HTTP) can share the same interface.

nodes.name: VectorSearch
nodes.summary: SQLite implementation of IVectorSearch. Loads embedding blobs scoped to the active embedding model, partitions rows into quantized vs Float32 formats, scores quantized rows via quantizedSearch and Float32 rows via cosine similarity, then merges and ranks results.

nodes.name: cosineSimilarity
nodes.summary: Computes cosine similarity between two Float32Array vectors using a single typed-array loop with no external math dependencies.

nodes.name: codec.ts
nodes.summary: Binary codec for quantized vector BLOBs: packs/unpacks bit-level quantization indices and encodes/decodes a 4-byte header carrying version, bit-width, flags, and an XOR checksum. The wire format shared by the quantizer, the search pipeline, and all three storage backends.
nodes.languageNotes: Header format: version (0x01), bit-width (1/2/4/8), flags, XOR checksum, then packed indices. At 4-bit, two indices fit per byte (high nibble first).

nodes.name: packIndices
nodes.summary: Packs an array of quantization indices into a compact byte array at the given bit-width, fitting multiple sub-byte indices per byte.

nodes.name: unpackIndices
nodes.summary: Inverse of packIndices: expands a packed byte array back into the original quantization index array given the bit-width and element count.

nodes.name: encodeHeader
nodes.summary: Builds the 4-byte blob header (version, bit-width, flags, XOR payload checksum) with validation of the bit-width value.

nodes.name: decodeHeader
nodes.summary: Parses and validates a 4-byte blob header, returning the structured BlobHeader fields.

nodes.name: encodeBlob
nodes.summary: Concatenates an encoded header with the packed-index payload to produce the final quantized BLOB stored in the database.

nodes.name: decodeBlob
nodes.summary: Splits a quantized BLOB into its decoded header and raw payload subarray.

nodes.name: expectedBlobSize
nodes.summary: Computes the expected byte size of a quantized blob for a given padded dimension and bit-width (header plus packed payload).

nodes.name: ranking-fidelity.ts
nodes.summary: Ranking fidelity eval for the quantization pipeline: ranks a corpus by cosine similarity using raw Float32 vectors and quantized-then-dequantized vectors, then compares the rankings via Spearman's rank correlation. Spec thresholds: rho >= 0.99 at 4-bit, 0.95 at 2-bit, 0.85 at 1-bit.

nodes.name: spearmanRho
nodes.summary: Computes Spearman's rank correlation coefficient between two score arrays, using tie-aware rank assignment.

nodes.name: assignRanks
nodes.summary: Assigns fractional ranks to a value array, averaging ranks across ties, as the building block for Spearman correlation.

nodes.name: evaluateRankingFidelity
nodes.summary: Runs the full ranking-fidelity evaluation for one bit-width: quantizes and dequantizes the corpus, scores every query against both representations, and reports mean/min/max per-query Spearman rho.

nodes.name: runner.ts
nodes.summary: Frozen quantization eval runner that combines ranking-fidelity and storage-metrics evaluations into a single pass/fail report. Defines the per-bit-width Spearman rho THRESHOLDS that must never be modified during quantization development.
nodes.languageNotes: Marked FROZEN EVAL in the header comment — thresholds (1-bit: 0.85, 2-bit: 0.95, 4-bit: 0.99, 8-bit: 0.999) are the AutoResearch source of truth and are intentionally immutable.

nodes.name: runQuantizationEval
nodes.summary: Executes ranking-fidelity evals across all bit-widths, attaches pass/fail against the frozen thresholds, appends storage metrics, and returns an aggregate QuantizationEvalResult with an overall allPass verdict.

nodes.name: storage-metrics.ts
nodes.summary: Storage metrics eval that measures actual on-disk compression ratios of the quantizer at each supported bit-width by quantizing a synthetic unit vector and comparing blob sizes against the Float32 baseline.

nodes.name: evaluateStorageMetrics
nodes.summary: Builds a normalized sample vector at the configured embedding dimension, quantizes it at every bit-width, and reports expected vs actual blob sizes and compression ratios.

nodes.name: hadamard.ts
nodes.summary: Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform (in-place, normalized butterfly algorithm, O(n log n)) plus zero-padding helpers. The Hadamard rotation distributes coordinate magnitudes uniformly so per-coordinate scalar quantization is near-optimal, per the TurboQuant paper (Zandieh et al., 2025).
nodes.languageNotes: The transform is its own inverse up to a scaling factor, so inverseHadamardTransform simply reapplies the normalized forward transform. Requires power-of-2 input length.

nodes.name: hadamardTransform
nodes.summary: In-place Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform normalized by 1/sqrt(n); throws if the input length is not a power of 2.

nodes.name: inverseHadamardTransform
nodes.summary: Inverse Hadamard transform — delegates to the forward transform, which is self-inverse under 1/sqrt(n) normalization.

nodes.name: zeroPad
nodes.summary: Zero-pads a Float32Array to a target power-of-2 length so it can pass through the Hadamard transform.

nodes.name: trimPad
nodes.summary: Trims a padded vector back to its original pre-padding length after the inverse transform.

nodes.name: lloyd-max.ts
nodes.summary: Lloyd-Max optimal scalar quantizers for Gaussian-distributed coordinates: computes optimal codebooks (centroids plus decision boundaries) for the standard normal via Lloyd-Max iteration, with memoized lookup per bit-width. After Hadamard rotation, each coordinate of a unit vector is approximately N(0, 1/paddedDim), making these codebooks near-optimal.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure dependency-free numerics: standard normal PDF/CDF, Acklam-style quantile approximation, and truncated-normal conditional means drive the Lloyd-Max fixed-point iteration. Codebooks are cached in a module-level Map keyed by bit-width.

nodes.name: normalCdf
nodes.summary: Numerical approximation of the standard normal cumulative distribution function used by the Lloyd-Max iteration.

nodes.name: stdNormalConditionalMean
nodes.summary: Computes the conditional mean of a standard normal restricted to an interval (truncated-normal mean), which becomes the optimal centroid for that quantization cell.

nodes.name: normalQuantile
nodes.summary: Approximate inverse CDF (quantile function) of the standard normal, used to seed initial decision boundaries for the Lloyd-Max iteration.

nodes.name: computeStdNormalLloydMax
nodes.summary: Core Lloyd-Max fixed-point iteration: alternates between updating centroids (conditional means of each cell) and boundaries (midpoints between centroids) until convergence, producing the optimal scalar quantizer for N(0,1).

nodes.name: buildCodebook
nodes.summary: Builds a Codebook for a given bit-width by running the Lloyd-Max iteration for 2^bitWidth levels and packaging sorted centroids plus decision boundaries.

nodes.name: getCodebook
nodes.summary: Memoized codebook accessor: returns the cached codebook for a bit-width or builds and caches it on first use.

nodes.name: quantizeScalar
nodes.summary: Maps a single scalar value to its quantization index via binary search over the codebook's decision boundaries.

nodes.name: dequantizeScalar
nodes.summary: Reconstructs a scalar value from its quantization index by looking up the corresponding codebook centroid.

nodes.name: migration.ts
nodes.summary: Background migration worker that converts stored Float32 embeddings to the quantized format in batches, verifying reconstruction quality (cosine similarity threshold) before overwriting each row. Progress is tracked in the migration_state table, making the migration resumable across restarts.

nodes.name: MigrationWorker
nodes.summary: Batch-processes the embeddings table: quantizes each Float32 vector, dequantizes it back, verifies cosine similarity against a configurable threshold, writes the quantized blob only if verification passes, and upserts resumable progress into migration_state.

nodes.name: quantized-search.ts
nodes.summary: Quantized-domain search executing similarity directly on packed indices via a two-pass pipeline: a fast SDC (symmetric, index-to-index table lookup) candidate pass followed by a precise ADC (asymmetric, query-float times centroid) re-ranking pass. Implements the TurboQuant search path used by all three vector-search backends.
nodes.languageNotes: SDC precomputes a 2^b x 2^b centroid dot-product table for O(1) per-coordinate scoring; ADC re-ranks only the top candidateCount survivors for precision.

nodes.name: prepareRotatedQuery
nodes.summary: Zero-pads a query vector to the configured padded dimension and applies the Hadamard rotation, placing it in the same rotated domain as stored quantized indices.

nodes.name: adcDotProduct
nodes.summary: Asymmetric distance computation: precise dot product between a rotated float query and a stored index vector via per-coordinate centroid lookup.

nodes.name: quantizeQueryIndices
nodes.summary: Quantizes a rotated query vector into codebook indices so it can participate in symmetric (SDC) scoring against stored indices.

nodes.name: buildSdcTable
nodes.summary: Precomputes the symmetric distance table of pairwise centroid products (2^b x 2^b) used for O(1) per-coordinate SDC lookups.

nodes.name: sdcDotProduct
nodes.summary: Symmetric distance computation: approximate dot product between query indices and stored indices via SDC table lookups.

nodes.name: quantizedSearch
nodes.summary: Top-level quantized search: decodes and unpacks every corpus blob, runs the fast SDC pass to select candidates, re-ranks them with the precise ADC pass, and returns the top-limit scored results. Falls back to scoring everything with ADC when the corpus is small.

nodes.name: turbo-quant.ts
nodes.summary: TurboQuant MSE orchestrator: the public quantize/dequantize API for 3072-dim Gemini embeddings. Encode pipeline is zeroPad(3072 to 4096) -> Hadamard -> Lloyd-Max scalar quantize -> pack -> header+payload; decode reverses it. Also provides blob format detection and a universal blob-to-Float32 converter used by every vector-search backend.
nodes.languageNotes: float32BlobSize is evaluated lazily at call time to avoid module-load-order crashes when CONFIG is partially mocked in tests.

nodes.name: quantize
nodes.summary: Quantizes a raw Float32Array embedding into a compact binary BLOB: pads, Hadamard-rotates, Lloyd-Max quantizes each coordinate with sigma scaling, packs indices, and prepends the codec header.

nodes.name: dequantize
nodes.summary: Reconstructs an approximate Float32Array embedding from a quantized BLOB: decodes the header, unpacks indices, dequantizes via the codebook, applies the inverse Hadamard transform, and trims padding.

nodes.name: isQuantizedBlob
nodes.summary: Heuristic format detector: identifies a blob as quantized when its size differs from the Float32 blob size and its first byte matches the codec header version.

nodes.name: blobToFloat32
nodes.summary: Universal blob converter: returns a Float32Array view for float32-format blobs and routes quantized-format blobs through dequantize, using the stored format string when available.

nodes.name: d1-vector-search.ts

nodes.name: backfillJunction

nodes.name: training-capture.ts

nodes.name: saveTrainingPair
nodes.summary: Inserts a single training pair (task type, input, output JSON, model, quality score, divergence flag, reasoning trace) into the training_data table.

nodes.name: getTrainingDataStats

nodes.name: iterateTrainingData

nodes.name: entity-extractor.ts
nodes.summary: Heuristic entity extraction engine that identifies libraries, services, tools, languages, frameworks, people, concepts, and files from text using regex patterns, a built-in alias map, and suppression/denylist filtering. Strips Claude Code system-reminder tags before matching to prevent garbage entities.

nodes.name: extractEntities

nodes.name: extractRelations

nodes.name: strip-system-tags.ts

nodes.name: stripSystemTags
nodes.summary: Applies four sequential regex passes (paired tags, self-closing, bare open, bare close) plus whitespace collapse to remove system-reminder tag markup from text.

nodes.name: database.ts
nodes.summary: SQLite database manager: opens/creates the Strata database with WAL pragmas and owns the full schema initialization — every table, FTS5 index, trigger, and in-place migration (knowledge PK rebuild, embeddings model column, training_data reasoning_trace) — plus FTS and importance backfills.

nodes.name: getDataDir

nodes.name: getDbPath

nodes.name: openDatabase

nodes.name: initSchema
nodes.summary: Creates the complete Strata schema — documents, knowledge, entities, embeddings, events, training_data, document chunks, turn tables — with FTS5 virtual tables and sync triggers, and performs guarded in-place migrations for older databases (PK rebuilds, added columns, FTS backfill triggers).

nodes.name: backfillKnowledgeFts
nodes.summary: Repopulates the knowledge_fts index from the knowledge table when row counts diverge, restoring full-text search coverage after migrations.

nodes.name: backfillImportance
nodes.summary: Batch-computes importance scores for knowledge entries and documents with NULL importance, using computeImportance inside chunked transactions to keep startup cost bounded.

nodes.name: health.ts
nodes.summary: Knowledge-base health derivation: runs five SQL-backed checks (embedding coverage, summary coverage, extraction success, entity quality, gap close rate) against configurable thresholds and aggregates them into an overall score and ok/warn/err status.

nodes.name: embeddingCoverage
nodes.summary: Measures the fraction of knowledge entries that have an embedding for the active embedding model and maps it to an ok/warn/err status.

nodes.name: summaryCoverage
nodes.summary: Computes the share of sessions that have a stored summary and grades it against configured thresholds.

nodes.name: extractionSuccess
nodes.summary: Estimates extraction success by comparing knowledge entry volume to session volume and grading the ratio.

nodes.name: entityQuality
nodes.summary: Measures the fraction of entities linked to knowledge entries via the junction table as a proxy for entity-graph quality.

nodes.name: gapCloseRate
nodes.summary: Computes the proportion of recent evidence gaps that have been resolved, grading the close rate against thresholds.

nodes.name: deriveHealth
nodes.summary: Runs all five health checks, averages their values into an overall 0-100 score, and reports err if any check errs, warn if any warns.

nodes.name: training-store.ts

nodes.name: PgTrainingStore
nodes.summary: Class wrapping a PgPool that implements saveTrainingPair, getTrainingDataCount, getTrainingDataStats, and getTrainingData against the Postgres training_data table.

nodes.name: projects.ts

nodes.name: normalizeProjectSlug

nodes.summary: Resolves a raw slug to its canonical project record, creating or updating the projects row and recording the raw form as an alias.

nodes.name: listProjects
nodes.summary: Returns all known project records with aliases parsed from JSON, ordered for display.

nodes.name: backfillProjects
nodes.summary: Scans distinct project values across historical rows and populates the projects table with canonical slugs, aliases, and first/last-seen timestamps; run automatically on database open.

nodes.name: sessions.ts

nodes.name: listCanonicalSessions
nodes.summary: Builds a multi-join SQL aggregation over documents, knowledge, events, and session summaries to produce paginated canonical session rows plus a total count, honoring project and since-time filters.

nodes.summary: SQLite-backed entity store for cross-session entity tracking: CRUD for entities, relations, and knowledge-entity junction links via prepared statements, plus search, top-entities, graph assembly, and type-distribution queries. Implements IEntityStore for pluggable storage.

nodes.name: SqliteEntityStore
nodes.summary: IEntityStore implementation with 14 methods covering entity upsert with occurrence counting, relation insertion, knowledge linking, name/type lookup, entity search, top-entity ranking, and entity-graph construction — all through cached prepared statements.

nodes.name: smart-summarizer.ts
nodes.summary: LLM-powered session summarizer that prompts a provider with a sanitized transcript to produce a structured SmartSummary (topic, decisions, solutions, patterns, learnings), captures successful (prompt, output) pairs as distillation training data, and falls back to the heuristic summarizer on any failure.
nodes.languageNotes: Graceful degradation pattern: every LLM failure path collapses to heuristicSmartSummary so callers never see an exception from summarization.

nodes.name: smartSummarize
nodes.summary: Builds a base heuristic summary, formats and sanitizes the transcript, calls provider.complete for structured JSON fields, saves the training pair on success, and falls back to the heuristic summary on any error.

nodes.name: heuristicSmartSummary
nodes.summary: Wraps a base heuristic SessionSummary into the SmartSummary shape with empty LLM fields and llmGenerated=false, serving as the no-LLM fallback result.

nodes.name: formatTranscript
nodes.summary: Renders session messages into a truncated speaker-labeled transcript and runs it through the Sanitizer so secrets never reach the LLM prompt.

nodes.name: parseJsonResponse
nodes.summary: Parses the LLM's raw response into the expected summary fields, validating array shapes and capping list lengths before use.

nodes.name: extractJson
nodes.summary: Extracts a JSON object from possibly-noisy LLM output by handling fenced code blocks and locating the outermost brace pair.

nodes.name: post-tool-failure-hook.ts
nodes.summary: Claude Code PostToolUseFailure hook: on tool failure it FTS5-searches the Strata document store for past solutions from the same project, suppresses near-duplicate recurring errors, and surfaces a qualifying match back to Claude via stderr with exit code 2.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses synchronous stdin reads and exit-code semantics (exit 2 = inject context, exit 0 = silent) per the Claude Code hooks contract.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Parses the failure payload from stdin, searches the document index scoped to the failing project, filters near-duplicate errors, and writes a formatted past-solution snippet to stderr when a relevant match is found.

nodes.name: isNearDuplicate
nodes.summary: Token-overlap similarity check between the current error and a candidate match, used to suppress recurring-error duplicates that are not actual fixes.

nodes.name: session-stop-hook.ts

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: End-to-end stop pipeline: reads the stdin payload, parses the session file, saves a summary, adds evaluated knowledge entries, races a dynamically-imported enhancedExtract against a timeout, then runs incrementalUpdate and closes the index manager.

nodes.name: teammate-idle-hook.ts

nodes.name: main

nodes.name: user-prompt-hook.ts
nodes.summary: Claude Code UserPromptSubmit hook: pattern-matches the user's prompt against error/recall/debug/decision trigger regexes and, only when triggered, runs a fast FTS search and injects matching past-context to stdout; silent in under 1ms otherwise.

nodes.name: detectTrigger
nodes.summary: Tests the prompt against the four trigger regex classes (error, recall, debug, decision) and returns the first match with its type, or null.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Reads the prompt payload, exits silently when no trigger fires, otherwise searches the document index with the cleaned prompt and writes up to a few dated context snippets to stdout for injection.

nodes.name: sqlite-index-manager.ts
nodes.summary: Central SQLite indexing engine: registers all five conversation parsers, builds full and incremental indexes of discovered sessions into documents/knowledge/summaries stores, chunks transcripts with word overlap, and optionally fans out to SVO event extraction and per-turn persistence.

nodes.name: SqliteIndexManager
nodes.summary: Owns the SQLite database plus document/knowledge/summary/meta stores and the parser registry; buildFullIndex and incrementalUpdate discover and (re)index sessions transactionally, indexFileWithParser chunks each session and extracts knowledge, and getStats reports index health.

nodes.name: aider-parser.ts

nodes.name: parseAiderMarkdown

nodes.name: extractAiderTools
nodes.summary: Infers tool names (file edits, shell commands) from assistant message text using marker substrings and fenced shell-block detection.

nodes.name: findAiderFiles
nodes.summary: Depth-limited recursive directory walk for .aider.chat.history.md files, skipping node_modules-style directories and hidden folders.

nodes.name: defaultTasksDir

nodes.name: extractClineText
nodes.summary: Flattens Cline's Anthropic-style content (string or block array) into plain text, including truncated tool_result content.

nodes.name: readTaskMetadata

nodes.name: codex-parser.ts

nodes.name: CodexParser

nodes.name: d1-knowledge-turn-store.ts

nodes.name: fuseRecallLanes

nodes.name: 0001_init.sql
nodes.summary: Initial Cloudflare D1 schema migration creating all 11 core Strata tables — documents, knowledge, knowledge_history, summaries, index_meta, embeddings, entities, entity_relations, knowledge_entities, evidence_gaps, and analytics — plus the documents_fts FTS5 virtual table with porter-stemmed insert/delete/update sync triggers and 17 indexes.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses SQLite FTS5 external-content tables (content=documents) kept in sync via AFTER INSERT/DELETE/UPDATE triggers — the standard pattern for BM25 search over a canonical table without duplicating storage.

nodes.name: documents
nodes.summary: Core conversation chunk store: each row is a document chunk with session, project, tool, role (user/assistant/mixed), timestamp, token count, message index, multi-tenant user scope, and an importance score.

nodes.name: knowledge
nodes.summary: Extracted knowledge entries (decisions, error fixes, learnings) with type, summary/details text, tags, related files, occurrence counts, and per-user multi-tenant scoping.

nodes.name: knowledge_history
nodes.summary: Audit trail of knowledge entry mutations, recording old/new summary and details plus the event type for each change to a knowledge entry.

nodes.name: summaries
nodes.summary: Per-session summary records keyed by session_id, capturing project, tool, topic, time window, message count, tools used, and a serialized data payload.

nodes.name: index_meta
nodes.summary: Key-value metadata store used for index bookkeeping, most notably the schema_version row that later migrations bump.

nodes.name: embeddings
nodes.summary: Vector embedding store keyed by knowledge entry id, holding the embedding blob, model name, creation timestamp, and storage format for semantic search.

nodes.name: entities
nodes.summary: Named entity registry with canonical name, aliases, type, first/last seen timestamps, mention counts, and project/user scoping for the entity graph.

nodes.name: entity_relations
nodes.summary: Directed edges between entities (source/target entity ids) with relation type, supporting context, and the session in which the relation was observed.

nodes.name: knowledge_entities
nodes.summary: Join table linking knowledge entries to the entities they mention (entry_id to entity_id many-to-many mapping).

nodes.name: evidence_gaps
nodes.summary: Tracks queries that were searched but never answered (evidence gaps), with gap type, context, and resolution metadata for later follow-up.

nodes.name: analytics
nodes.summary: Event log for usage analytics, storing event type, serialized event data, timestamp, and session/project/user scope.

nodes.name: 0002_quantization_support.sql
nodes.summary: D1 migration adding the migration_state table that tracks progress of embedding vector quantization bit-width migrations (current/target bit width, vector counts, status, timestamps).

nodes.name: migration_state
nodes.summary: Single-row state tracker for in-flight quantization migrations: current and target bit widths, total versus migrated vector counts, status, and start/completion timestamps.

nodes.name: 0003_knowledge_fts.sql
nodes.summary: D1 migration replacing D1KnowledgeStore's full-table LIKE scan with a porter-stemmed FTS5 virtual table (knowledge_fts) over knowledge summary/details/tags, including sync triggers, a backfill of existing rows, and a schema_version bump to 3.
nodes.languageNotes: External-content FTS5 (content=knowledge) avoids duplicating text storage; the 'delete' command rows in the triggers are the FTS5 idiom for removing stale index entries on update/delete.

nodes.name: knowledge_fts
nodes.summary: FTS5 virtual table indexing knowledge summary, details, and tags with porter stemming and BM25 ranking, content-linked to the knowledge table.

nodes.name: 0004_knowledge_turns.sql
nodes.summary: D1 migration adding the turn-level lane for Turn Isolation Retrieval (TIR): a knowledge_turns table storing verbatim per-turn content with session/project/user scoping, a porter-stemmed knowledge_turns_fts FTS5 index with sync triggers, and a schema_version bump to 4. The lane is additive and starts empty until IncrementalIndexer populates it.
nodes.languageNotes: Schema mirrors the NPC v2 npc_turns table with project and user_id columns added for Community multi-tenant scoping; message_index supports +/-1 neighbor expansion at retrieval time.

nodes.name: knowledge_turns
nodes.summary: Per-turn verbatim conversation store keyed by turn_id UUID, with session_id, nullable project and user_id scopes, speaker role, raw content, message_index ordinal, and creation timestamp.

nodes.name: knowledge_turns_fts
nodes.summary: FTS5 virtual table over knowledge_turns content with porter stemming, kept in sync via AFTER INSERT/DELETE triggers for BM25 turn-level search.

nodes.name: 0005_embeddings_model_default.sql
