nodes.languageNotes: Color output is initialized once via initColor and applied through small curried helpers (bronze, bright, muted, success, active, text, dim) reflecting the Antikythera bronze brand palette.

nodes.name: wordWrap
nodes.summary: Wraps a string to a given width on word boundaries, returning the array of wrapped lines for box-formatted CLI output.

nodes.name: init-gemini.ts
nodes.summary: Implements `strata init-gemini`, which integrates Strata into a Gemini CLI project: checks prerequisites, writes the .gemini MCP server config, registers lifecycle hooks, installs skill and command templates, updates GEMINI.md with Strata guidance, and ensures the data directory exists.

nodes.name: extractProjectName
nodes.summary: Derives a project name for the Strata config from package.json or the directory basename.

nodes.name: checkPrerequisites
nodes.summary: Validates that the target directory is a usable Gemini CLI project before any files are written, returning actionable error messages on failure.

nodes.name: writeMcpConfig
nodes.summary: Creates or merges the .gemini settings JSON to register the Strata MCP server entry, preserving existing user configuration.

nodes.name: registerHooks
nodes.summary: Registers Strata lifecycle hooks (such as session-start context injection) in the Gemini CLI settings, resolving hook script paths and merging idempotently with any hooks already present.

nodes.name: installSkills
nodes.summary: Copies Strata skill markdown templates into the project's Gemini skills directory, skipping existing files unless force is set.

nodes.name: installCommands
nodes.summary: Installs Strata custom command definitions (recall, remember, and similar) into the Gemini CLI commands directory, converting templates to the expected TOML/markdown format.

nodes.name: updateGeminiMd
nodes.summary: Appends or refreshes the Strata memory-usage section in the project's GEMINI.md, using markers to keep the managed block idempotent across re-runs.

nodes.name: runInitGemini
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the full init-gemini flow: prerequisites, MCP config, hooks, skills, commands, GEMINI.md update, and data directory creation, with a step-by-step progress report.

nodes.name: init.ts
nodes.summary: Implements `strata init` for Claude Code projects: copies skill templates into .claude/skills, registers Strata hooks in settings.json, appends the Strata memory section to CLAUDE.md from a template, and ensures the data directory exists.

nodes.name: copySkills
nodes.summary: Copies skill markdown files from the bundled templates/skills directory into the project's .claude/skills directory, skipping existing files unless force is set.

nodes.name: registerHooks
nodes.summary: Merges Strata hook entries (such as the session-start context hook) into the project's .claude/settings.json, resolving hook script paths and avoiding duplicate registrations.

nodes.name: appendClaudeMd
nodes.summary: Appends the Strata memory-usage section from CLAUDE.md.template to the project's CLAUDE.md, substituting the project name and skipping when the section already exists.

nodes.name: extractProjectName
nodes.summary: Derives the project name from package.json or the directory basename for template substitution.

nodes.name: runInit
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the init flow for Claude Code projects: installs skills, registers hooks, updates CLAUDE.md, and creates the data directory with step-numbered console output.

nodes.name: rest-migrate.ts
nodes.summary: Implements `strata rest-migrate`, which moves flat REST-transport agent directories ({baseDir}/<agentId>/strata.db) into the per-player layout ({baseDir}/players/<playerId>/agents/<agentId>/strata.db), with dry-run support and refusal to merge into an existing player directory.

nodes.name: runRestMigrate
nodes.summary: Scans baseDir for top-level agent directories containing strata.db and renames them under players/<playerId>/agents/, skipping reserved names and returning a moved/skipped report.

nodes.name: nomic-prefix.ts
nodes.summary: Maps Gemini-style embedding taskType strings to the instruction prefixes required by nomic-embed-text-v1.5 (search_query vs search_document), part of the provider-agnostic local embedding support.
nodes.languageNotes: The trailing space in each prefix is significant — it separates the instruction from the input text per the nomic model contract.

nodes.name: nomicPrefixFor
nodes.summary: Returns 'search_query: ' for retrieval/code query task types and 'search_document: ' for document indexing and unknown task types.

nodes.name: license-validator.ts
nodes.summary: Community-edition stub for license validation: validateLicense always returns invalid with a message directing users to install @kytheros/strata-pro, and generateTestLicense throws. Defines the LicenseTier/LicensePayload/LicenseResult types shared with the Pro implementation.

nodes.name: validateLicense
nodes.summary: Always returns an invalid LicenseResult instructing the user that license activation requires the strata-pro package.

nodes.name: subagent-start-hook.ts
nodes.summary: Executable SubagentStart hook that emits JSON hookSpecificOutput injecting Strata MCP tool awareness (search_history, find_solutions, store_memory, and proactive-usage rules) into every spawned subagent's context.
nodes.languageNotes: Reads the hook payload from stdin with a fixed 16KB buffer and fails silently so a broken hook never blocks agent spawning.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Parses the optional stdin payload, builds the Strata MCP guidance block, and prints the SubagentStart hookSpecificOutput JSON before exiting 0.

nodes.name: recommended-agent-prompt.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the recommended Strata agent pipeline prompts: a system prompt, a unified type-label-free user template folding in recency, counting, temporal, and preference answering disciplines, and buildRecommendedPrompt to substitute context, date, and question.
nodes.languageNotes: The PREFERENCES bullet is deliberate anti-abstention guidance that recovers single-session-preference accuracy without per-question type labels.

nodes.name: buildRecommendedPrompt
nodes.summary: Substitutes {context}, {date}, and {question} placeholders into the user template and returns the paired system and user prompts.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel export for the reasoning module: re-exports the tool-calling provider interface types, question-type procedure helpers (classifyQuestion, getProcedure, getToolSubset), and the production agent loop engine (runAgentLoop).

nodes.name: query-expansion.ts
nodes.summary: Pseudo-relevance feedback (PRF) for hybrid search: extracts distinctive non-stopword terms shared across top vector-search results and builds an expanded FTS5 query, creating keyword signal that lets the RRF dual-list bonus promote entries with both keyword and semantic relevance.

nodes.name: extractExpansionTerms
nodes.summary: Tokenizes top vector-result texts and returns terms that appear in at least minDocFreq documents, excluding stopwords and original query terms, capped at maxTerms.

nodes.name: buildExpandedFTSQuery
nodes.summary: Combines the original FTS5 query with OR-joined expansion terms to form the expanded full-text query string.

nodes.name: question-classifier.ts
nodes.summary: Heuristic question-type classifiers used to route retrieval behavior: detects temporal-reasoning, knowledge-update, multi-session aggregation, preference, and single-session-assistant questions via keyword and pattern markers, with classifyQuestionType combining them into a single label.

nodes.name: isTemporalReasoningQuestion
nodes.summary: Returns true when the question contains temporal-reasoning markers such as date arithmetic, ordering, or relative-time phrasing.

nodes.name: isKnowledgeUpdateQuestion
nodes.summary: Detects questions about the current/latest value of a fact that may have been superseded, signaling recency-weighted retrieval.

nodes.name: isMultiSessionQuestion
nodes.summary: Detects counting/aggregation questions that must combine evidence across multiple sessions (how many, totals, list-all phrasing).

nodes.name: isPreferenceQuestion
nodes.summary: Detects preference/recommendation questions that should be answered from the user's explicitly stated preferences.

nodes.name: isSingleSessionAssistantQuestion
nodes.summary: Detects questions about what the assistant itself said or suggested in a prior session, which require assistant-turn retrieval.

nodes.name: classifyQuestionType
nodes.summary: Combines the individual predicates with precedence rules (including strong-aggregation markers) to produce a single question-type label for retrieval routing.

nodes.name: session-ndcg.ts
nodes.summary: Pure computation module for session-level DCG scoring: aggregates a session's chunk positions in the global ranked list so sessions with multiple high-ranking chunks compound signal instead of being capped by single-best-chunk deduplication.

nodes.name: computeSessionDcg
nodes.summary: Sums 1/log2(rank+2) over a session's chunk ranks in the global fused list to produce the session's discounted cumulative gain score.

nodes.name: config-editable-keys.ts
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for dashboard-editable CONFIG keys, shared by the Pro PUT /api/settings/config allowlist validation and the Pro Dashboard ConfigEditor: each entry pins dot-path, type, default, bounds, section, a locked flag for AutoResearch-tuned values, and a restart flag for module-load-time values.
nodes.languageNotes: Keys marked locked are AutoResearch-tuned parameters; the SPA requires an explicit confirm before editing them, mirroring the repo policy of not changing eval-optimized values casually.

nodes.name: validateOverride
nodes.summary: Validates a proposed override against the EDITABLE_KEYS catalog: rejects unknown paths, wrong types, and out-of-bounds numbers, returning a structured error or ok result.

nodes.name: dashboard-overrides.ts
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for reading, writing, and merging dashboard-driven config overrides stored as flat dot-path keys in ~/.strata/dashboard-overrides.json; applyOverrides walks each dot-path onto the compiled CONFIG defaults at process start (hot reload deferred to v1.3).
nodes.languageNotes: Dot-path flat format keeps the file human-editable and avoids deep-merge edge cases of full-tree shapes.

nodes.name: loadOverrides
nodes.summary: Reads and parses the overrides JSON file, returning an empty map when the file is missing or malformed.

nodes.name: patchOverrides
nodes.summary: Merges a partial override map into the persisted file, deleting keys whose new value is null and saving the result.

nodes.name: applyOverrides
nodes.summary: Applies the persisted dot-path overrides onto a deep clone of the compiled CONFIG defaults, replacing each leaf value.

nodes.name: legacy-layout.ts
nodes.summary: World-scope refactor guard: hasLegacyLayout detects pre-refactor JSON FS-tree layouts (profile.json, character.json, relationship.json markers) so `strata serve --rest` can refuse to start against unmigrated data while allowing valid post-refactor SQLite-only directories.

nodes.name: hasLegacyLayout
nodes.summary: Walks agents/ and players/ subdirectories looking for any pre-refactor JSON marker file, returning true if one is found and false for empty, migrated, or post-refactor directories.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documents the Strata Postgres migration conventions: NNNN_description.sql naming, the forward-only no-down-migrations policy (rollback = restore from backup), how the startup migration runner applies and checksums files, related environment variables, and the schema_migrations tracking table.

nodes.name: optional-deps.d.ts
nodes.summary: Ambient TypeScript declarations for optional dynamically-imported dependencies, currently typing the @huggingface/transformers pipeline function and env cache directory used by the local embedder.

nodes.name: context-budgeter.ts
nodes.summary: Context budget management ported from Kytheros: ContextBudgetManager performs heuristic token counting (CJK-aware) against a context window with fixed overhead and output reservation, firing one-shot warning (70%), compaction (80%), and critical (95%) threshold callbacks.

nodes.name: ContextBudgetManager
nodes.summary: Tracks token usage against a configurable context window: countTokens estimates tokens with a CJK-aware heuristic, recordTokenUsage accumulates usage and checks 3-tier thresholds, and getBudgetStatus/isBudgetExceeded/reset expose budget state to callers.

nodes.name: agent-integration-readonly.md
nodes.summary: Template snippet for read-only research agents: lists the Strata memory skills and MCP tools to use before researching (/recall), for project state (/strata-status), pattern checks (find_patterns), storing insights (/remember), and gap review (/gaps).

nodes.name: agent-integration-readwrite.md
nodes.summary: Template snippet for read-write agents: instructs proactive use of Strata memory skills (/recall before debugging, /remember after decisions or fixes, /strata-status, /gaps) plus the direct MCP tool list for search and storage.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md.template
nodes.summary: Mustache-style template for generating a project CLAUDE.md that instructs AI coding assistants to use Strata memory tools (find_solutions, store_memory, get_project_context) and lists when to store memories.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses {{PROJECT_NAME}} / {{PROJECT_DESCRIPTION}} placeholders filled in by the Strata init/scaffolding flow.

nodes.name: package.json.tmpl
nodes.summary: Template package.json for scaffolded Cloudflare D1 worker deployments, wiring wrangler dev/deploy/migrate scripts and a strata-mcp dependency with a {{TIER_DEPS}} placeholder for tier-specific packages.

nodes.name: index.community.ts
nodes.summary: Community-tier Cloudflare Worker entry template: validates a gateway bearer token, extracts a per-user UUID from /strata/{userId}/mcp, builds D1-backed storage plus dense turn-lane infrastructure (D1KnowledgeTurnStore + D1VectorSearch with a null embedder), and serves Strata's MCP server over Web-standard streamable HTTP.
nodes.languageNotes: Dense turn-lane is wired infra-only — the embedder is late-injected via initEmbedder() when GEMINI_API_KEY is present, and search degrades gracefully to FTS5-only until a Community D1 ingest path exists.

nodes.name: index.pro.ts
nodes.summary: Pro-tier Cloudflare Worker entry template: same gateway-token auth and per-user UUID routing as the Community variant, but boots createProServer from @kytheros/strata-pro with a Polar license key over D1-backed storage and streamable HTTP transport.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the D1 worker template: ES2022 target with bundler module resolution, strict mode, noEmit, and @cloudflare/workers-types ambient types.

nodes.name: wrangler.toml.tmpl
nodes.summary: Wrangler configuration template for the scaffolded D1 worker: declares the src/index.ts entry, nodejs_compat flag, a STRATA_DB D1 database binding, and comments documenting the MCP_GATEWAY_TOKEN and GEMINI_API_KEY secrets.
nodes.languageNotes: Placeholders {{WORKER_NAME}}, {{DB_NAME}}, {{DB_ID}}, and {{TIER_SECRETS_COMMENT}} are substituted by the scaffolder per tier.

nodes.name: legacy-layout.test.ts

nodes.name: rest-migrate.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests runRestMigrate, the CLI migration that moves flat agent directories under players/<id>/agents/, covering dry-run reporting, skipping dirs without strata.db, reserved-name exclusions, and refusal when the target player already exists.

nodes.name: world-refuse-start.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration tests that spawn the real CLI (src/cli.ts via npx tsx) to verify 'serve --rest' refuses to start on legacy data layouts and that the world-migrate command migrates them, while post-refactor and empty data dirs start normally.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses spawnSync with shell:true for Windows npx resolution and rmSync maxRetries to tolerate EBUSY on SQLite file handles.

nodes.name: spawnCli
nodes.summary: Synchronously spawns the Strata CLI with a given STRATA_DATA_DIR and timeout, returning normalized exitCode, stdout, and stderr for assertions.

nodes.name: nomic-prefix.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for nomicPrefixFor, verifying Gemini-style embedding task types map to nomic-embed prefixes: document tasks to 'search_document: ', query tasks to 'search_query: ', and unknown/undefined defaulting to document.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Excludes node_modules, build artifacts, tests, and dev files from the Docker build context to keep image layers small and reproducible.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Node.js 22 Alpine build: a builder stage compiles TypeScript via npm run build, then a slim runtime stage copies dist/ and node_modules, runs as the non-root strata user, exposes port 8080, and launches the MCP server via dist/cli.js serve.
nodes.languageNotes: Multi-stage build pattern separates compile-time deps (python3/make/g++ for native modules like better-sqlite3) from the runtime image, which only carries libstdc++ alongside the compiled output. HEALTHCHECK is configured for orchestrator liveness.

nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Single-service Docker Compose definition that builds the Strata image, maps host port 3000 to container 8080, mounts a named volume for /data persistence, and forwards STRATA_LICENSE_KEY for Pro tier activation.

nodes.name: aws-template-apply.yml
nodes.summary: Manually-triggered GitHub Actions workflow that applies (or destroys) the AWS dev environment Terraform stack via `task dev:up`/`dev:down` using OIDC-federated deploy role assumption.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses OIDC federation (id-token: write) to assume a deploy role without long-lived AWS credentials, and pins all actions to SHA digests for supply chain hardening.

nodes.name: aws-template-ci.yml
nodes.summary: Pull-request CI pipeline for AWS Terraform templates running fmt, validate, tflint, checkov, tfsec, and plan-on-PR jobs via dynamic matrix path discovery.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a discover job to dynamically build a Terraform path matrix from versions.tf locations, then fans out validation jobs across each path.

nodes.name: ci.yml
nodes.summary: Main pull-request and push CI workflow running build, tests, security audit, and license compliance checks for the strata-mcp package.

nodes.name: publish.yml
nodes.summary: Tag-triggered workflow that publishes strata-mcp to npm when a `v*` git tag is pushed.

nodes.name: security.yml
nodes.summary: Security scanning pipeline running Semgrep SAST, Gitleaks secret detection, and npm audit on pull requests with a gate job and PR comment summary.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: Single job that gates on a confirmation string, configures OIDC AWS credentials, runs `task dev:up` (or `dev:down`), and uploads orchestrator outputs as an artifact.

nodes.name: discover
nodes.summary: Discovers all Terraform module paths under templates/aws by searching for versions.tf files and emits a JSON matrix for downstream fan-out.

nodes.name: fmt
nodes.summary: Runs `terraform fmt -check -recursive` across the entire templates/aws tree to enforce formatting consistency.

nodes.name: validate
nodes.summary: Per-path terraform validate job with backend disabled, fanned out across the discovered Terraform module matrix.

nodes.name: tflint
nodes.summary: Runs tflint static analysis on each discovered Terraform module to surface style and provider issues.

nodes.name: checkov
nodes.summary: Runs Checkov IaC security/compliance scanning against each Terraform module for misconfiguration detection.

nodes.name: tfsec
nodes.summary: Runs tfsec security analysis against Terraform modules to detect known security issues in infrastructure code.

nodes.name: plan-on-pr
nodes.summary: Runs `terraform plan` on pull requests to surface the proposed infrastructure diff before merge.

nodes.name: build-and-test
nodes.summary: Installs dependencies, builds TypeScript, and runs the strata test suite on every PR and push to main.

nodes.name: security-audit
nodes.summary: Runs npm audit and Semgrep static analysis to surface dependency vulnerabilities and code-level security issues.

nodes.name: license-check
nodes.summary: Validates dependency licenses to ensure no incompatible licenses are introduced into the project.

nodes.name: publish
nodes.summary: Builds the package and runs `npm publish` to release strata-mcp to the npm registry on version tag push.

nodes.name: semgrep
nodes.summary: Runs Semgrep SAST scan using custom rules from .semgrep/custom-rules.yml to detect secrets, injection, and prototype pollution issues.

nodes.name: gitleaks
nodes.summary: Runs Gitleaks scan against the repository to detect leaked credentials and secrets in commits.

nodes.name: npm-audit
nodes.summary: Runs npm audit to surface vulnerabilities in transitive dependencies of the strata-mcp package.

nodes.name: security-gate
nodes.summary: Aggregates results from Semgrep, Gitleaks, and npm audit and fails the workflow if any ERROR-severity finding blocks the PR.

nodes.name: pr-comment
nodes.summary: Posts a summary comment on the pull request with security scan findings from all upstream jobs.

nodes.name: knowledge_history

nodes.name: summaries

nodes.name: index_meta
nodes.summary: Generic key-value store for indexer metadata such as schema version, last-indexed pointers, and run state.

nodes.name: embeddings

nodes.name: entities

nodes.name: entity_relations

nodes.name: knowledge_entities
nodes.summary: Junction table linking knowledge entries to entities, supporting entity-scoped knowledge lookups.

nodes.name: evidence_gaps
nodes.summary: Tracks queries that returned no useful results so the system can surface unanswered evidence gaps and resolution state.

nodes.name: analytics
nodes.summary: Append-only analytics events keyed by event_type and timestamp, scoped to session/project/user for usage reporting.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand what Strata is: persistent memory for AI agents, delivered as an MCP server that auto-indexes conversations from Claude Code, Codex, Aider, Cline, and Gemini CLI into a local SQLite knowledge base — scoring 81.1% on LongMemEval-500. The architecture doc previews the journey ahead: SQLite + FTS5 storage, a BM25 + vector + RRF hybrid retrieval stack, and a quality-gated write pipeline. Keep two ideas in mind as you tour: everything runs locally by default, and the same engine deploys as hosted multi-tenant infrastructure.

tour.title: Entry Points: Binary & CLI
tour.description: The strata-mcp binary starts at src/index.ts, which creates the MCP server via createServer() and connects it over stdio — the default transport used by Claude Code and other local MCP clients. src/cli.ts is the richer front door: it routes between starting the server (stdio, HTTP, multi-tenant, REST) and subcommands like build-index, migrate, and distill. Together they show the project's dual nature: a drop-in MCP tool and a deployable service.

tour.title: The MCP Server Factory
tour.description: createServer() in src/server.ts is the composition root — with 42 outgoing dependencies, it wires the SQLite index manager, search engines, semantic bridge, embeddings, and all 15 MCP tool handlers into one server instance. The optional { dataDir } parameter is what makes multi-tenant hosting possible later: each tenant gets its own createServer() with an isolated database. Almost every module you'll see in this tour is assembled here.
tour.languageLesson: The factory-function pattern (createServer(options)) is TypeScript's lightweight alternative to dependency-injection frameworks: all wiring happens in one function whose closure owns the instances, so tests and multi-tenant pools can create fully isolated servers just by calling it again.

tour.title: Central Config & Tuned Parameters
tour.description: src/config.ts is the second most depended-upon file in the codebase (77 incoming edges). It defines filesystem paths under ~/.strata plus every empirically tuned search parameter — BM25 weights, RRF constants, chunk sizes, importance scoring. These values are not guesses: they were optimized by the AutoResearch eval loops you'll meet in Step 13, which is why the project rule says never change them without re-running the frozen evals.

tour.title: Auto-Indexing Conversations
tour.description: This is the passive write path: a parser registry holds five ConversationParser plugins (Claude Code, Codex, Aider, Cline, Gemini), with session-parser.ts handling the core JSONL transcript format. The incremental indexer watches session files and re-indexes only what changed, while sqlite-index-manager.ts orchestrates full and incremental index builds, chunking sessions at the config-tuned size. The result: your AI conversations become searchable without you doing anything.

tour.title: The Quality-Gated Knowledge Pipeline
tour.description: Strata's differentiator from 'store everything' memory layers: extracted knowledge must pass deterministic quality gates before storage. The extractor pulls decisions, error fixes, and learnings from parsed sessions; the evaluator scores each candidate on actionability, specificity, and relevance and rejects low-value entries; knowledge-store.ts defines the KnowledgeEntry shape and type taxonomy everything downstream relies on. The evaluator-pipeline doc explains the three gates with examples — this is the README's 'clean and auditable knowledge base' claim, implemented.

tour.title: Storage Backends & Database Schema
tour.description: The most depended-upon file in the entire graph (93 incoming edges) is database.ts — the SQLite manager that opens the database with WAL pragmas and owns schema initialization. The storage factory routes to one of three backends: SQLite locally (default), Cloudflare D1 at the edge, or Postgres on Cloud Run, all implementing the same store interfaces from interfaces/index.ts. Compare the D1 init migration's 11 core tables with the Postgres baseline's 16 — same logical model (documents, knowledge, embeddings, entities, evidence_gaps), adapted per backend.
tour.languageLesson: TypeScript's structural typing makes the three-backend design work: SQLite, D1, and Postgres stores all satisfy interfaces like IKnowledgeStore without declaring inheritance. On the SQL side, numbered migration files (0001, 0002, ...) apply incremental, ordered schema changes so each backend's database can evolve alongside the code.

tour.title: Hybrid Search & Ranking
tour.description: The retrieval heart of Strata. sqlite-search-engine.ts fuses FTS5 BM25 keyword hits, vector chunk similarity, the dense turn-lane (Step 11), and knowledge-entry expansion into one candidate pool; result-ranker.ts applies reciprocal rank fusion plus recency, project, and importance boosts at both chunk and session granularity. The embedding-provider interface (with the Gemini embedder as default) supplies the vector side — and the engine degrades gracefully to keyword-only search when no API key is present. The semantic-search-bridge adapts it all to the community SearchResult shape the tools consume.
tour.languageLesson: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) merges ranked lists from incompatible scorers (BM25 scores vs cosine similarities) by summing 1/(k + rank) per document — only positions matter, so no score normalization is needed. It's the standard trick behind hybrid keyword+vector search.

tour.title: The MCP Tools Surface
tour.description: Everything so far becomes agent-usable here. search_history is the main retrieval entry point — it fuses FTS, TIR+QDP, knowledge, and dense turn-lane candidates, and its retrieval_strategy="deep" parameter unlocks the full benchmark-grade pipeline. store_memory is the explicit write tool: importance scoring, entity extraction and linking, and the Step 6 quality gates all fire on each stored memory. The TOOLS doc catalogs all 15 tools — note how each one is a thin handler delegating to the engines you've already seen.

tour.title: NEW: The Conversation-Ingest Write Path
tour.description: The newest piece of the architecture (issue #30): hosted deployments can't watch local transcript files, so ingest-turns.ts provides an explicit write path that persists turns, chunks, and knowledge entries per session — with replace-session idempotency so re-ingesting is safe. One implementation, two surfaces: the ingest_turns MCP tool and the POST /ingest/turns HTTP route, which validates the tenant header and delegates to the same shared function on both multi-tenant transports. The test file is worth reading as executable documentation of the contract.
tour.languageLesson: The dual-surface pattern — one core function exposed through both an MCP tool and a REST route — keeps behavior identical across protocols. Idempotent writes (replace-by-session-id rather than append) are essential for ingestion APIs, because clients retry.

tour.title: Dense Turn-Lane Retrieval
tour.description: Strata's biggest measured retrieval win (+21pp on single-session-assistant questions): give every conversation turn its own vector embedding instead of relying only on chunk-level search. dense-turn-fusion.ts RRF-fuses per-turn vector hits into the chunk-lane results from Step 8. The turn store is implemented three times against one IKnowledgeTurnStore contract — SQLite FTS5, Postgres tsvector, and Cloudflare D1 — and the D1 migration shows the knowledge_turn_embeddings table that backs the vector side. The lane activates automatically when an embedding provider is present, with STRATA_DENSE_TURN_LANE=off as the kill switch.

tour.title: Hosted & Multi-Tenant Transports
tour.description: The same createServer() from Step 3 scales from laptop to SaaS. The single-tenant HTTP transport serves Streamable HTTP on /mcp; the multi-tenant transport runs one shared process for all users via an inline LRU database pool, scoping each request by the X-Strata-User header behind a verified auth proxy; the Postgres variant swaps the pool for per-tenant storage over a single pg.Pool. The REST transport is a different animal entirely — game-engine endpoints with two-tier HMAC token auth and per-NPC memory scoping for Unity, Godot, and Unreal. All of them mount the POST /ingest/turns route from Step 10.

tour.title: Evaluation: LongMemEval & Frozen AutoResearch Evals
tour.description: How does Strata know its retrieval claims are real? The LongMemEval harness measures task-averaged accuracy across 500 questions with the TIR+QDP flag on versus off — the source of the 81.1% headline and the +21pp dense turn-lane validation. The AutoResearch directories hold frozen eval scripts: the hybrid search-retrieval eval (30/30 ceiling), the turn-lane ranking eval, and the ssa-dense-turn-lane eval that gated Step 11's production graduation. The discipline: the eval script never changes during optimization, one variable changes per iteration, and the benchmarks doc publishes the results.

tour.title: Packaging, CI & Release
tour.description: The capstone: how all of this ships. The Dockerfile uses a multi-stage Node 22 Alpine build — a builder stage compiles TypeScript, then a slim runtime stage carries only what the server needs, ready for the Cloud Run and Workers deployments described in Step 12. CI runs build, the 2,400+ test suite, security audit, and license checks on every PR; pushing a v* tag triggers the publish workflow that releases strata-mcp to npm. From a transcript on your laptop to a versioned package on the registry — the full loop.
tour.languageLesson: Multi-stage Docker builds use multiple FROM statements: the builder stage holds dev dependencies and the TypeScript compiler, while the final stage copies only compiled output and production deps — typically cutting image size by 50-80%. In GitHub Actions, the `on: push: tags` trigger is the standard release gate.
